_comment: Physicals pillar SCORING config (Phase 2). Separate from balance.json (which holds the cross-pillar importance/target the Balance engine ranks by). This file tunes how the Physicals synthesizer (lib/physicals-synthesizer.mjs) turns recovery_state + Tempo's synced wellness stores into the 4 Area sub-scores and the composite. Kyle's tuning surface — edit values here, no code change. NOTE: sleep.targetHours and weights are council-invented defaults ratified 2026-06-08 (the Tempo app has no sleep-debt formula and never composites these metrics); recovery/ACWR/meds mirror existing app semantics (tempo-coach readinessBand, recovery_state ACWR display, analytics.getMedAdherence).
